result: Running gradient descent on the centered function f(x + u) − f(x) − ∇f(x)ᵀu from random noise extracts a negative-curvature direction with first-order information only (NEON); a Nesterov version is quadratically faster, giving saddle-escaping SGD in time almost linear in d.
result_plain: NEON: noise + gradient descent on a centered function finds negative curvature without Hessians.
